Read a workbook of the digitizer, every landmark included

Source: R/analysis_project.R
read_digitizer_workbook.Rd

Reads a sheet of the workbook written by digitize_landmarks() (or rebuilt by consolidate_landmarks()) into an "intrait_landmarks" object, with one row of the coordinate array per landmark NUMBER, from 1 to the largest present (up to 25): the hinges 22, 24 and 25 of curved specimens are found by their position, so that fishmorph_segments() measures standard length along them; a landmark absent from the sheet (23, the derived head base, often) is NA. Every other column of the sheet becomes metadata.

Usage

read_digitizer_workbook(path, sheet = "measurements", max_landmark = 25L)

Arguments

path

The workbook (.xlsx).

sheet

"measurements" (default) or "bias" (repeated digitizations: the specimen identifier is then built from individual, operator and replicate when there is no specimen column).

max_landmark

Largest landmark number read.

Value

An "intrait_landmarks" object.

See also

fishmorph_segments(), write_analysis_project()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
fish <- read_digitizer_workbook("landmarks.xlsx")
rat  <- fishmorph_ratios(fishmorph_segments(fish, scale_cm = 1))
} # }
